title: Human bottleneck reset event 70,000 years ago

tellings.quote: Well, there there are people who feel strongly that there have been reset events, right? Human history reset events. For instance, 70,000 years ago, we know genomically there was a bottleneck.

plain: Some people believe human history has had "reset events", and one example offered is a genetic bottleneck about 70,000 years ago, when, judging by our genes, the human population shrank drastically. This is raised by Jack, Michels' co-host and technical correspondent, who goes by a pseudonym and has worked for years in defense and aerospace, without naming a source.
